responsibility: Implements spelling-suggestion support for GCC tree identifiers. It adapts the generic edit-distance machinery to IDENTIFIER_NODE trees, computes distances using identifier spelling and length, and selects the closest meaningful identifier from a candidate vector for use in frontend diagnostics that suggest likely intended names.
same_name_distinction: Implementation file for the tree-specific spellcheck layer: it computes identifier edit distances and chooses the best matching IDENTIFIER_NODE candidate, whereas spellcheck-tree.h declares those entry points and the tree specialization that adapts the generic spellcheck framework.
